title: IMM-Core: Interview Metadata Model — Core Profile
description: A generic, openly published minimal metadata model for interview-based qualitative research. Discipline-agnostic (oral history, sociology, anthropology, education, migration studies, health research). Two-layer architecture: Core Profile (generic, 15 fields in blocks A–C; Block D reserved for profiles) plus Implementation Profiles (specialisations). Includes DCTAP single source of truth, JSON Schema validator, offline record checker and Dataverse converter, three example records, four crosswalks (Dublin Core, REFI-QDA/QDPX, Schema.org/Dataset, Dataverse), one worked reference profile, and full conceptual documentation.

creators.name: Behnam Shad, Klaus
